summary: Held through 10 frames of normal chop between roughly -7 and +15 pts, treating each dip as noise since it kept snapping back to new highs. Bailed at t=11m when price broke to -23.25, a clean break below the entire prior range with the 5s bar closing at its low, HA/PROPP both flipping against, and ER10 collapsing to 0.06 -- that combination read as a genuine structure break rather than another dip. Next time I'd watch for the range-break-plus-efficiency-collapse combo earlier as the wrong-direction tell, rather than waiting for it to compound further before confirming.
